name: 44308 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44308 (Akron) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44308 (Akron) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
